scope: Native document module exception reporting and inline root identity; not a signed-worker conformance result

targeted_tests.fixture_note: Both pinned-harness tests are normally ignored because they require ORYN_WPT_ROOT; both were explicitly executed with --include-ignored, in both allow_uncaught_exception modes.

native_matrix.fixture_note: All tests executed separately with --include-ignored and ORYN_WPT_ROOT configured.

contracts: Compile/link exceptions are caught before loss of their original value, then reported through rejected-promise reactions.
Native rejection handlers remain attached across top-level await; cancellation suppresses diagnostics; uncanceled delayed errors are recorded once without duplicate unhandled-promise reporting.
Ordinary execute_module API continues to return failures without Window error delivery.
Inline root modules are distinct, dependency instances remain shared, and reusing an external root does not rerun its body.
Inline import.meta.url uses the document URL and document.currentScript is null.
Rejection diagnostics do not invoke an arbitrary payload toString.
The existing wall deadline terminates an infinite module error handler and the host recovers.
limitations: Module load-event and document-load barriers while evaluation promises remain pending are not implemented by this change.
Module fetch failures, CORS response metadata, and complete source URL/base handling still require validation and fixes.
Precise source coordinates for arbitrary primitive promise rejections are not validated; inline HTML document offsets remain open.
Node-listener exceptions, callback script muting, initial frame realms, worker propagation and remaining global event handlers remain open.
No new signed-worker full run; baseline remains 2559/4022.
